replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a statistical technique used to reduce the dimensionality of a dataset while preserving as much variance as possible. To perform PCA, you first need to standardize the data, so that each feature has a mean of zero and a standard deviation of one. Then, you compute the covariance matrix of the data.
